notes.title: [MCTO prevention & action against abnormal program use]
notes.content:
[b]We have been receiving increased user complaints revolving around hack use, offensive language, and other discriminatory incidence. As such, we will be implementing strict guidelines to moderate in-game environment and reduce malignant elements including hacks and abnormal/offensive behavior.[/b]

Prevention of illegal/abnormal program use:
1.	Anti-cheat program use
-MCTO is currently utilizing XIGNCODE3 as the first line of defense against hack programs. XIGNCODE3 searches for abnormal parameters and creates a separate log file where we are able to reference key traits in determining irregular activities per account. We are also consistently updating XIGNCODE3 DB with new hack programs available in the market.
2.	In-game ‘report’ system
-In addition to our Anti-cheat program, our users are able to report suspicious hackers in the following two ways;
a) User report option:
-Users are able to report hackers through an in-game option (F3). Once someone has been reported, relevant information including screenshots will be compiled into our ‘report’ DB which we will cross reference the user in question with other necessary data to determine whether they are indeed hacking.
b) AI referee option (auto kick/report function)
-We are implementing a multi AI referee system where once an abnormal gameplay becomes flagged, the System will automatically query our AI referees to collect a vote to either report/kick the user in question. Due to potential abuse, we are unable to disclose details of factors considered by our AI referees in conducting their votes.

Action against illegal/abnormal program use:
1.	Rules of Conduct
-For everyone who have not yet reviewed our Rules of Conduct, please find our posting on: (http://www.metroconflict.com/rules-of-conduct.html)
-We reserve the right to restrict those who disregard our Rules of Conduct at any time without prior notice.
2.	Restriction standard
-At MCTO, our user-focused priority revolves around creating and maintaining a positive gameplay environment where all users feel comfort while enjoying the game. Please review our standard listed below on how we determine restrictions upon users who do not comply with our guidelines.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30960024/07c9976b2e165a40af87f30295dbb1575bac3c8a.png[/img]

-Standard table seen above is subject to addition as well modification at any time as deemed necessary by MC Team.
3.  Disclosure of restricted accounts
	-Please note that we may, at any time, disclose a list of users who have been restricted from MCTO for reasons corresponding to the aforementioned table.
-Anyone who would like to appeal for the removal of their restriction, please email us at mcsupport@redduck.com 

At MCTO, we will continue to develop ways to improve user experience. Thank you again for your understanding and cooperation.

MC Team.

notes.title: [Character Balance Notice]
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30960024/32d85aabeebfdffa952c6ab24ffc73be7a4e6be4.jpg[/img]
[h1]From our latest patch on January 5th Friday, we have received various feedback regarding overall character balances. We are planning to continue our character balances through our upcoming January 11th patch.[/h1]

[b][u]Minigun modification:[/u][/b]
-	One of the most voiced concerns by our user base was regarding Bigdaddy’s increased defensive capabilities as well as survivability. While it was our intent to increase survivability, our users believe his Minigun’s offensive capability was also significantly improved due to him withstanding more punishment.
-	We have decreased the Minigun’s accuracy to affect his offensive capability. With this new change in the weapon’s spread, we expect to keep his survivability whilst balancing his offensive capability.

[b][u]Sniper HP reduction & damage revision to SR weapons:[/u][/b]
-	Feedback regarding Snipers have also been provided by our community and the general consensus was that Snipers were buffed in their offensive capability while receiving a minor HP increase. 
-	Our focus was to retain bolt-action sniper rifle’s 1-shot kill mechanic through the overall HP increase. We have modified (reduced) SR weapon damage enough to allow 1-shot kills (within a reasonable distance).
-	We have reduced/rebalanced Sniper character HP in general to withstand at least one grenade from Geoffrey’s grenade launcher but become more susceptible against AR character.

[b][u]Removal of Igor’s shotgun switch delay:[/u][/b]
-	We’ve received mixed feedback regarding Igor through our recent patch. There were few users who thought Igor was buffed dramatically through the HP increase. While his survivability was indeed improved through increased max HP, his offensive capability through shotguns & SMGs have been reduced significantly. (Considering all characters have had their max HP increased accordingly)
-	Igor is a defensive specialist overall, but we want to retain his game-changing Blind Storm + takeover mechanism. As such, we have removed his previous switch delay nerf when swapping between his shield and shotgun.

[b][u]Increased ammo:[/u][/b]
-	We have received various feedback regarding the side effect of max HP increase towards Assault Rifles characters. We were able to compile such feedback into two distinct suggestions.
1) AR damage was too low in comparison
2) Not enough bullets to sustain throughout battle
-	For our upcoming patch on January 11th, we have increased the total number of magazine for all weapons in exception of Trish-specific rifles.
-	It is our intention, by increasing the overall max HP value for all characters in order to create sufficient room for weapon-specific rework in the near future. We are currently considering to modify weapon damage (and relative stats) in order to achieve diverse weapon types respective to their native trait.
example) current AK & M4 series do not offer significant strength of their own (including damage output & spray control) for users to choose from. In the future, we would be able to create enough of a difference between weapon types to promote weapon-specific play style.

[b][u]EXD – Health Pack nodes:[/u][/b]
-	We have increased EXD mode Health Packs from 100 HP recovery to 200 HP recover.

[b][u]Miscellaneous feedback:[/u][/b]
-	SMG, Hand-grenade, Pistol damage rework suggestion.

We will continue to monitor gameplay as well as user feedback to continue implementing changes to character/weapon balances. It is our intention to conduct weekly balance changes through our patch notes.
It’s realistic that we are unable to meet everyone’s needs, but we would like for all of our users to know that the very foundation of all game changes start and finish with user feedback. We hope that you will continue to engage in communication with us through Discord, Community Hub, and Forum. 


Thank you

MC Team

- We have reduced/rebalanced Sniper character HP in general to withstand at least one grenade from Geoffrey’s grenade launcher but become more susceptible against AR character.

notes.title: Metro Conflict: The Origin [Path Note #7]
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30960024/2a0b3d1ad84656c7830bf974e8c98e1a1cdda510.jpg[/img]
[h1]Happy New Year & we wish everyone the best in 2018![/h1]

[b][Game Play][/b]
[list]
[*]1.	General Character balance to promote teamwork and team-wide skill usage.
- Refer to ‘Character balance notes’ below
[*]2.	Construction Site (EXD) map respawn location rebalance.
- We have changed the respawn point for the team that brings the marker to their spawn point in order to counter marker spawn camping
[*]3.	Matchmaking minimum requirement changes. (room creation- 4:4 -> 5:5 / further map votes- 3:3 -> 4:4)
- We have reduced the total number of players required to join a new game in the past due to lack of concurrent players. It was our intention to promote faster matchmaking queues at low concurrent number of users. However, faster matchmaking was at the cost of more frequent 6v6 complete team play experience.
- Through the revision of minimum required number of players for matchmaking, we are expecting more frequent ‘full’ matches for everyone to enjoy.
[/list]
[b][System][/b]
[list]
[*]1.	SEA(South East Asia) Server added
[/list]
[b][Content][/b]
[list]
[*]1.	Christmas package (Seasonal Skins) are no longer available through in-game store or though reward crates.
[/list]
[b][Bug Fixes][/b]
[*]1.	We have fixed a known issue where Anti-Cheat software would not allow certain users to log into the game correctly. (further fix from previous patch)
[*]2.	We have fixed an issue where new patch updates would automatically reset user preferences in-game (including; sound settings, graphics settings, and gameplay configuration).
[/list]
[b][Known Issue][/b]
[list]
[*]1.     Group matchmaking queue error connecting your group to other regional servers. (currently being fixed)
[*]2.     Fullscreen & UI display error (currently being fixed)
[/list]

[b][u]Character Balance Notes:[/u][/b]

We consider this section as one of the most important update made in this patch as it is directly connected to how we intent for game play experience to be transferred through to our users.
When we consider Metro Conflict: The Origin, we believe one of the core elements we would like to highlight is Character uniqueness and respective skill utilization as a team. With this being said, MC Team took a careful look into what and how we could alter or modify segments of the game to further emphasize the importance of such team play.
We have collected various feedback from our awesome community members and started to conduct internal testing with significant changes made to characters & skill sets.
Understanding how current version of EXD works as a fast-paced aim-reliant game, we wanted to slow down the overall pace of the game and promote larger battle scenarios with more than 3-4 players per side working together whilst retaining the importance of individual aim.
Through our internal testing, we have seen how our changes in this patch have successfully stressed the value of teamwork more so than ever.

[b][u]There are two major changes;[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]1.	Improvement in character survivability.
- Characters are now able to withstand more punishment before becoming defeated in the firefight. This factors into slowing down the overall gameplay speed and also promote a more strategic approach teams to consider advantageous positions.
[*]2.	Improvement in character specific ‘roles’.
- We were careful not to rework characters in a way where their identity is completely altered. Rather, we focused on granting each character a unique role to be played within a team setting without categorizing them as ‘Tank’, ‘DPS’, or ‘Support’.
[/list]

[b]Character specific changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]1.	All characters have had their HP modified to withstand a bit more punishment respectively to the role they should play within the team.

Character	Skill	Pre-change
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30960024/9a60fa5039c6e45621477561af2a4e96ce98a428.png[/img]

[*]2.	We have not (yet) implemented changes to all weapons in exception of Sniper Rifles and Grenades. Bolt-action (1 hit kill) snipers have a long history throughout FPS games and we did not want to remove that style through this change. Therefore, Sniper Rifle damage has been modified. Hand Grenades have had their damage increased as well.
[/list]
We are excited to hear your feedback on our Character rebalance and hope to see more team play in action. It is important for everyone to understand that these changes are not final in any sense and we will continue to modify areas to improve the overall user experience. Please continue to share your feedback with us through our Discord, Steam Community Hub, and Forums suggestions & feedback section.


Thank you 

MC Team.

notes.title: [Solution] Anti-Cheat related game client crash
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings![/h1]

We have recently received feedback from various users regarding an unknown game client crash at boot up.

Our technical team had taken a deeper look into this issue and have found a solution which will automatically be applied as a client patch. 

We expect that this patch will resolve all issues related to game client crashes but in case you are still experiencing the same problem post-patch, please refer to the following steps;
[list]
[*]1.	Head to your XignCode folder within your main MTCO installation folder. 
-	Generic location: Steam\steamapps\common\Metro Conflict - The Origin\Binaries\XignCode

[*]2.	Locate and delete two files (xmag.xem, xxd-0.xem) and restart the game client. 
-	Please do not alter or delete any files other than the two mentioned above.. 
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30960024/d5f3d05c717cc0f74c4bf16ee2a0180c0a27c1f9.png[/img]

If you are still experiencing game crashes after patch application as well as manual file deletion, please contact us at mcsupport@redduck.com

Thank you,
 
MC Team.

notes.title: Dev Note #5. Graphic settings
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30960024/989a18cd48b005a1bef67fe5a95903447c5c14b9.jpg[/img]
[h1]Ever since the Early Access launch of Metro Conflict: The Origin, one of the most feedback we have received has to do with Graphics related issues.
We believe many such questions and concerns may be answered simply through detailed explanation of Graphics options. In this Dev Note, we’ll try to guide everyone through graphic settings.[/h1]

First and foremost, we’ll take a look at customizable graphic options.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30960024/8c4101fa4e55818bab2ab73ebcc8d194f69a9227.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30960024/0e29e73bd9152d7d70a25b1ef5af001492222d42.png[/img]
As we breakdown each Graphic options (refer to above table), we now understand what each option actually does to the in-game visuals. One of the most ‘popular’ issues addressed to us was regarding how turning off the ‘Auto Setting’ and manually turning up all graphics options didn’t seem to change anything. The main reason many people felt this way was due to how our current Texture Quality was being set in-game.
While background & character settings can be manually chosen, Texture Quality is currently designed to reflect your PC’s GPU memory to automatically default to the highest possible Texture settings. This in turn may create two conflicting scenarios. First, your GPU memory had already set your Texture Quality to max and therefore would not change the outcome of lowering/increasing the level of quality manually. Second, it could be that your PC is unable to support best possible Texture Quality due to low GPU memory regardless of manual input.
It is our intention for MCTO Client to automatically factor in your PC memory, GPU memory capacity, and 32/64bit OS in order to set your in-game graphics to an optimal level without having to force any strains upon your gaming setup. 
This automatic Texture Quality function has created an illusion of manual settings not correctly working through the Video Options.
There are rare cases where graphic options are incorrectly set despite your sufficient GPU memory. We’ve found that the game client currently has several GPU models missing from its list of recognized units.
Our technical team is currently adding any missing GPUs including newly released models to the list. If you feel that your graphics setting is functioning irregularly, please feel free to report it to us on our forums and/or Steam Bug reports. 

We are currently planning to improve overall graphics quality in the near future. It is our intention to clarify Video setting options in order to improve the UX. We will also be increasing maximum Texture quality in order to accommodate high-end GPUs.
We hope this post was helpful for those who may have been confused with how Video settings were supposed to work. We understand that there is always room for Graphics related errors which may not be related to this posting and we hope that, in such cases, you will help bring it to our attention where we will try our best to address the issue as soon as possible.
Metro Conflict: The Origin will continue to improve Gameplay graphics as much as we can. We thank you again for your support and future changes to game graphics will be announced through patches.

Thank you,

MC Team

notes.title: Metro Conflict: The Origin – Free to Play Transition Announcement
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30960024/e2092245afb00df52892904be1c0991f1731203d.jpg[/img]
[h1]Dear valued users.
This announcement is to notify everyone of an important upcoming change to Metro Conflict: The Origin’s game service.[/h1]

[b][Background][/b]
Metro Conflict: The Origin (MCTO) started its Early Access approximately 2 weeks ago. We thank everyone who had supported us through Early Access as well as those who joined us via Free Trial version.
We were successful in receiving various feedback (both positive & negative) through all of our users for the past couple of weeks. Such feedback, ideas, community engagements have all proven vital in our steps in further developing Metro Conflict: The Origin into ‘the game’ our users would love to play.

[b][Focus][/b]
MCTO’s core identity is and will always be an online multiplayer FPS. With this said, one of the most important issues in our game would be directly comparable to the number of concurrent users within the game server. During the first several days of Early Access launch, we’ve experience significant delays in matchmaking due to low volume of users with respect to our regional servers. In hopes that we would resolve this matter for our Early Access users, MC Team decided to open up a Free version of MCTO for the public to access (Demo/Trial version). We were successful in saturating our Asia server with enough user base for match making to be quick and effective for all of our users but, unfortunately, we are still experiencing user traffic problems in NA/EU/SA servers alike. Both MC Team and our valued community members share the same viewpoint with regard to wanting an increased gamer population for all respective regional servers so that everyone could enjoy playing MCTO in their own server(s).
While the ‘Demo/Trial version’ option is indeed available on our Steam Store page, it is apparent that many either have the wrong idea as to how our Demo/Trial version works, or simply don’t know about it due to the lack of visibility. Therefore, we have decided to resolve this issue by transitioning our Steam Store page from Early Access to the Free access version in order to promote users to come and join us without having to feel that they must pay to play MCTO.

[b][Action][/b]
[u]MC Team have decided on the following;[/u]
[list]
[*]Early Access (Full Character package) users will retain their rights as EA participants (refer to prior post regarding EA participation perks) and continue to possess all game progress without the concern of data wipe.
[*]Early Access is scheduled to be discontinued once our Steam Store page is modified to display our 3-character basic Free to Play package as the main download option.
[*]Metro Conflict: The Origin will be visible to everyone as a Free to Play game through Steam platform with an optional ‘Full Agents Package’ DLC.
[*]‘Full Agents Package’ is a separate downloadable content which will grant Free Access users with 9 additional Agents, character oriented weapons, and 440,000 in-game gold for $19.99.
[/list]
MC Team has always disclosed our belief in communicating with our community members. We would like to continue listening to our community and work together with everyone to mature Metro Conflict: The Origin.
As we move forward, we would like to applaud our Early Access users for being the heart of our community and we continue to ask for your support. In order for us to say “thank you”, we’ll be providing exclusive skins for all Early Access participants which will not be available at any time to anyone other than our Early Access users. 

[b]Early Access Skins:
Chris ‘KillerRoseSkin’	&	“SAIGA-12 Zombie Buster’[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30960024/ecfaf15f7bbd9a7c3deb233036ac4e3b5c425a13.jpg[/img]

[i]Above skins will become tradable within the Steam Community Market in the future.[/i]

Metro Conflict: The Origin’s transition to Free to Play details will be announced through a separate posting once schedule is confirmed. Sincere appreciation from the MC Team towards all of our valued users! Thank you.

MC Team.

notes.title: Metro Conflict: The Origin. Patch Note #1
notes.content:
[h1][b]As we look back at our first week of Early Access Launch, we've received a lot of feedback regarding various elements found within the game. We will continue to fix bugs, tune balance, and modify issues as we move forward but we ask everyone to be patient while we implement changes through weekly patches.[/b][/h1]

[b][u]Patch Notes:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Metro Conflict: The Origin Free Trial Access (refer to appropriate posting)
[*]Friend's list bug fix - We've corrected an error where users were forced to exit to main lobby in order to add new friends.
[*]Match-making changes - MM was modified to create a new game when minimum of 8 people are present (4v4). Minimum of 6 total players must be in the map-change lobby in order to continue.
[*]Match Waiting FFA skill bug fix - We have fixed a random bug which incorrectly applied Character Skill while inside MWFFA.
[*]EXD Boost - We will be adding 100% gold & XP boost to all EXD players during the 2nd week of Early Access. We're also considering to add additional crates to encourage players to experience EXD game mode.
[*]EXD rule changes - Further explanation below.
[/list]

EXD Rule Changes:
Extreme Domination' true value stems from how versatile gameplay and strategy can become in order to achieve victory over opponents. Many of our EA users have said that the amount of 'Restore Score'(aka: depleting enemy's score) towards the end of the game is too quick and offers game turning events more often than expected. We've rebalanced the equation to now emphasize teamwork more than before. There are now greater benefit in having multiple teammates within the active circle compared to having just one person stations. Through this change, we hope to encourage players to work as a team to quickly overtake lost points by moving & playing together.

Following is the calculation change we've made to the EXD mode:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30960024/9ce8a5c799f22dd8f5687112de0c9898fceac465.jpg[/img]

We look forward to more feedback as we head into week 2!


MC Team.

notes.title: Metro Conflict: The Origin News Update!
notes.content:
[h1][b]We would like to provide an important update regarding Metro Conflict: The Origin.[/b][/h1]

We have received great user feedback, ideas, and insight on Metro Conflict: The Origin during the past several days!

Through our Early Access Launch last week, we have closely monitored user traffic on all of our servers while simultaneously listening to what our community was saying about their initial game experience.
While we have received positive reviews regarding gameplay, many of our users were experiencing difficulty with finding a match in their respective region. Regardless of how enjoyable a game can be, it means little if you can't play it! 

In order for us to alleviate this issue as quickly as possible, we have decided to launch Metro Conflict: The Origin 'Free Trial Version' for users to access our game free of charge!

[b][u]Metro Conflict: The Origin (Free Trial Version) includes the following;[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]1. Starter's Agent Pack (Striker, Bigdaddy, Geoffery)
[*]2. 160,000 In-game starting gold
[*]3. Full access to grindable game content in-sync with Early Access & Official versions
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30960024/41cad80e4d4ac0ecd378c5194857117278283d27.jpg[/img]

We would like to let all of our users know that Metro Conflict: The Origin is meant to be a Package game. We do not have plans to add micro transactions in the future. It was a difficult decision for us to consider offering Free Access to the game, but the most important thing for us at this time was to correct the lack of user-traffic issue in order that our Early Access users are able to enjoy our game without waiting in queue delays. 

We do encourage new users to join us in Metro Conflict: The Origin either through Early Access; which includes full game content, or by downloading our Free Trial Version expected to be available very soon through our Steam Store.

Please note that we do not plan on discontinuing our services for Free Trial Version accounts but the downloadable Free Trial Version Store Page may be subject to be taken down in the future.

All Early Access users will be invited to participate in our weekly/bi-weekly Developer discussion where your voice will directly impact future changes to Metro Conflict: The Origin. You will also gain access to development knowledge inaccessible to the Free Trial Version users.

Hope to see you all in-game!

MC TEAM.

notes.title: Welcome to Early Access!!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Metro Conflict: The Origin is finally opening its doors to the public through Early Access.[/b][/h1]

[b]Through our recent Beta test, we were able to collect diverse feedback and user insight on Metro Conflict: The Origin. The very purpose we’ve had in mind conducting Beta test was to hear what our users had to say! 
We’re very excited to come across such an awesome collective community of users who took the time to share with us; Pros & Cons of Metro Conflict: The Origin.
As we launch Metro Conflict: The Origin through Early Access, we would like for everyone to comprehend the potential in what Metro Conflict is able to become. We, the developer, do not consider Metro Conflict: The Origin as a finished game but rather as a starting point of a great game in the making! We may be the ones to deliver your content but our user community and their voices are the foundation of our game development.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30960024/d3b757ab70a79372f18d0a49fb78f1f1fb44d0e8.jpg[/img]

[b][h1]Metro Conflict: The Origin Early Access Launch
-Date & time: 2017 Nov 8th 11:00PM (PST)

[b][i][u]Early Access Updates:[/u][/i][/b]

[*]DEM Mode: Cliff Side, Union Station[/list]
2.	New Character Skin
[list][*]Tiffany Rose-pink Skin (Obtainable through Winner’s Crate)[/list]
3.	EXD Mode gameplay changes:
[list][*]We’ve taken into consideration; various user feedback related to the EXD mode. We have added clarity to where ‘Marker’ could be setup by either team. We’ve also enlarged the proximity radius around the ‘Marker’ in order to promote team fights.
[*]We do intend to keep a close eye on our EXD gameplay in order to balance the overall game mode and create an enjoyable experience for our users.[/list]
4.	UI/UX fixes:
[list][*]We’ve received numerous feedback related to the game lobby operating in Window mode. As such, we have defaulted our lobby to Full Screen. Please note, that we are aware of partial fonts and/or images lacking sharpness compared to the rest. We will be fixing this issue through patches in the near future.
[*]There may be limitations in dramatic changes to the overall UI and/or HUD at this time but we are planning to implement changes according to ideas & feedback provided by our Community members.[/list]
5.	Miscellaneous:
[list][*]We have modified the default server connection in order for you to automatically connect to the nearest located Server. You may still ‘choose’ your server region manually.
[*]Misguiding and/or unclear descriptions have been modified.
[*]We’ve created a function regarding language where Metro Conflict: The Origin will automatically set in-game language to correspond with your Steam Account’s language preference. [*]We’ve increased ‘Call Sign’ character limit from 10 characters to 16 characters. We have also enabled the option for non-English speakers to create their ‘Call Sign’ in their native language; if the language is supported by the game.[/list]
6.	Known Issues:
[list][*]We are aware of the confusion caused by MWF(Match Waiting FFA) allowing players from different servers to connect into a mutual game channel. We are already working on differentiating MWF channels in order to eliminate such confusion among our players. We ask you for your patience as we work on the solution.
[*]Players are given two different types of Crates obtainable through gameplay which, by % chance, may drop unique items (including skins). There is a known bug where identical item drops simply disappear from your inventory. We are planning to fix this issue in the near future so that you are able to possess multiple items of the same kind.

[b]In order to show our appreciation to all of our Beta Test Participants, we have prepared a special Crate for you which will be available in your Inventory. 
We would like to thank everyone for your amazing support!

  
MC Team.[/b]

notes.title: Dev. Note #4. Character Skills!
notes.content:
[h1][b]For our 4th chapter in Dev. Notes, we will be reviewing 12 unique skills available in Metro Conflict: The Origin.[/b][/h1]


 

[h1]Main Skills;[/h1]

[b]Geoffrey[/b]
[list]
[*][Shockwave]: Creates an EMP field with a 7m radius centered at where Geoffrey initiated the skill. Those who are caught by Shockwave become impaired in their movement as well as their aim for up to 3 seconds. They also receive minor damage from the skill (1hp/sec)
[*][Duration]: 3 seconds
[*][Cool down]: 120 seconds
[*][Tips]: Shockwave can have a devastating effect when used in a narrow area in order to choke enemy movement.
[/list]
[b]Igor[/b]
[list]
[*][Blind Storm]: Blind Storm creates a 9.8m radius Electro-Magnetic bubble which temporarily blinds enemies who are caught within the storm.
[*][Duration]: 5.5 seconds
[*][Cool down]: 190 seconds
[*][Tips]: Blind Storm can be a great tool both; offensively & defensively. It can also be used to cancel out Hawkeye’s Motion Sensor detection.
[/list]
[b]Lopez[/b]
[list]
[*][Teleport]: Summons two bi-directional teleportation portal that last 3 minutes. Portals can be placed anywhere on the map and cannot be destroyed.   
[*][Duration]: 180 seconds
[*][Cool down]: 80 seconds
[*][Tips]: First portal, once placed, will stay active without a time limit. Try to time the placement of the second portal to meet your team’s strategy. 
[/list]
[b]Rona[/b]
[list]
[*][Shadow Dance]: Rona’s holographic replication can be directly controlled as if it was actually Rona. The Hologram can be used to check around corners or create confusion among enemy players. Vision gained by Shadow Dance is shared with Rona and her team mates.
[*][Duration]: 15 seconds
[*][Cool down]: 150 seconds
[*][Tips]: Shadow Dance is great for scouting dangerous territories but it can also draw fire from enemies while team mates engage them in battle.
[/list]
[b]Tiffany[/b]
[list]
[*][Recover Health]: Recover Health has a 30m radius which heals all team mates within the radius for 20hp per second for 6 seconds.
[*][Duration]: 6 seconds
[*][Cool down]: 50 seconds
[*][Tips]: Recover Health can be timed together with other agent skills in order to regenerate to full HP. (ie: Recover Health + Body Armor)
[/list]
[b]Striker[/b]
[list]
[*][Body Armor]: Grants the user and all team mates within a 15m radius 99% damage reduction armor for 2.1 seconds. (Does not block Headshots)
[*][Duration]: 2.1 seconds
[*][Cool down]: 180 seconds
[*][Tips]: Activating Body Armor at significantly low life can work as a bait for enemies to over commit their engagement.
[/list]
[b]Chris[/b]
[list]
[*][Micron]: When activated, Chris shrinks his size by 75% for 8 seconds. There is a HP penalty during Micron which reduces Chris’ life down to 30hp.
[*][Duration]: 8 seconds
[*][Cool down]: 135 seconds
[*][Tips]: Micron can be used not only during combat but also for moving past chokepoints with ease. Due to Micron’s HP penalty, be aware of activating the skill against AOE damage dealers (ie: Geoffrey, Lopez)
[/list]
[b]Trish[/b]
[list]
[*][Stealth]: Upon Activation, Trish becomes invisible for up to 10 seconds. She is able to move around freely without being seen but Stealth becomes deactivated when Trish fires her weapon.
[*][Duration]: 10 seconds
[*][Cool down]: 130 seconds
[*][Tips]: Stealth can be used to play mind games with enemy users. Try and position yourself at an advantageous angle to take out the enemy.
[/list]
[b]Hawkeye[/b]
[list]
[*][Motion Sensor]: For the duration of the skill, Hawkeye and his team mates gain vision of all enemy players for 6 seconds. Enemy users revealed by Motion Sensor receive warning labels on their screen.
[*][Duration]: 6 seconds
[*][Cool down]: 200 seconds
[*][Tips]: Motion Sensor can be used to figure out where enemy players are stations. This information can be vital in trying to figure out the opposition’s strategy.
[/list]
[b]Ana[/b]
[list]
[*][Dash]: Ana is able to speed up movement speed of herself and her allies within a 20m radius for 5 seconds. Dash grants a burst in ‘forward’ movement speed which is 1.7 times faster compared to normal movement speed.
[*][Duration]: 5 seconds
[*][Cool down]: 140 seconds
[*][Tips]: Dash can be used to allow the whole team to storm a location quickly.
[/list]
[b]El Tigre[/b]
[list]
[*][Energy Shield]: El Tigre and his team mates within a 20m radius receive an energy shield which absorbs all explosive damage made against them for 11 seconds.
[*][Duration]: 11 seconds
[*][Cool down]: 90 seconds
[*][Tips]: Geoffrey’s grenade launcher and the infantry mortar used by Lopez can become useless due to how Energy Shield works. Geoffrey’s Shockwave is also considered as explosive damage. Use Energy Shield to cancel out Shockwave effect.
[/list]
[b]Big Daddy[/b]
[list]
[*][Maximum Armor]: For 5 seconds after activation, Maximum Armor creates a barrier for all allies within a 20m radius. Players who gain Maximum Armor barrier will receive 80% reduced incoming damage from all bullet-type attacks. (including headshots)
[*][Duration]: 5 seconds
[*][Cool down]: 130 seconds
[*][Tips]: Maximum Armor can have great effect when used in the midst of a large firefight.
[/list]
 

[h1]Secondary Skills (incl. Passive);[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Igor[/b] – Martyrdom(Passive): Even in death, Igor bring fear to those around him by blowing himself up to damage those close by.

[*][b]Ana[/b] – High Jump: She is able to maneuver over obstacles in dire situation.

[*][b]El Tigre[/b] – Sliding: El Tigre can literally slide in and out of combat quickly.

[*][b]Striker[/b] – Sprint: Striker is able to quickly sprint to flank enemies or join team mates in battle.
[/list]



[b]I hope this posting gives a deeper insight to all of our users :)[/b] 




[b]MC Team.[/b]

notes.title: Dev. Note #3. Game Mode!
notes.content:
[b]Today’s posting is about our new game mode; EXD (Extreme Domination)!

Throughout our development of Metro Conflict: The Origin here at Red Duck, Inc., various new maps and games modes have been continuously added. As of now, there are more than 10 different game modes along with dozens of new maps.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30960024/8e6ce2de90d6ef526b782c1619aa47c106f9996d.png[/img]
As we were preparing for Metro Conflict: The Origin’s release, the most significant focus in mind was not about how many game modes we have available nor the vast catalog of maps we have prepared; but rather the importance of providing unique gameplay experience through introducing a concept unseen from previous FPS titles available on the market.

While reviewing through each game mode we had prepared for Metro Conflict: The Origin, we were looking for two distinctive features to be offered to our users; ‘Enjoyable gameplay experience’ & ‘Fresh style of gameplay’. Through such internal review, we’ve decided to bring you EXD (Extreme Domination).[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30960024/0ed33c9f87274b5741d4080f3f7ac1c56f9d1234.jpg[/img]
[i]Let’s take a closer look into how EXD mode is designed to be played:[/i]
[list]
[*]EXD mode is a 6 vs 6 team match where an objective known as ‘Marker’ requires to be obtained from a neutral location be either team. Once the ‘Marker’ is obtained, it can be carried to a location of choice and activated to win the match.
[*]Successful ‘Marker’ activation requires for it to be setup and have, within its proximity, at least one team member for the ‘Marker’ to completely finish becoming activated.
[*]Opposing team may, at any time, stop the activation by either; removing any/all players within the designated proximity of the ‘Marker’, or physically steal the ‘Marker’ away from the opposition by picking it up from its set location.
[*]Character dynamic & relative skill combination is a significantly vital element in successfully obtaining, and defending/capturing the ‘Marker’. Map utilization, individual aim, and teamwork are all the more important due to the nature of EXD objective model.
[*]EXD mode allow users to have much more freedom in the overall gameplay. For example, some teams may forcefully create an added advantage by choosing a strategic location for the ‘Marker’ placement in order to funnel enemy movement. In a grander scheme of things, users may effectively conjure new strategies built on various character combinations to gain leverage over opponents.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30960024/266b04d5fe08723f66de70eccae5236807a8c43e.jpg[/img]
[b]We believe in the growth potential that EXD offers in both; casual & competitive gameplay. Through our CBT, we hope to receive your feedback in which we will consider it as our initial evaluation of EXD. Suggestions and ideas including addition, supplication, and also revision of rules & structure would be very much appreciated.[/b]

That was indeed a long posting! 
Seeing it and experiencing it for yourselves would definitely be best. So make sure you’ve signed up for our CBT but until then, enjoy this informative EXD gameplay video!
[h1]
[b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/256699204/movie480.mp4?t=1508915150]Extreme Domination![/url]
[/b]
[/h1]

Team MC.

notes.title: Dev. Note #2. Game Cost!
notes.content:
[b]In continuation of the previous post, we would like to further elaborate on the game cost.
Here at Red Duck, we pride ourselves in having exceptional experience with over 10 years of experience developing & servicing various Free to Play models and therefore fully understand the positive aspects of F2P as well as its limitations in terms of game’s progressive growth. Therefore, one of several significant decisions we’ve made in relation to launching Metro Conflict: The Origin was the transition from ‘Free to Play’ to ‘Pay to Play’. The idea is for our users to purchase our full game which includes all content to be accessible without having to pay for additional elements to fully experience the gameplay. This change also allows our game to be and remain a balanced online multiplayer FPS where we can strictly avert away from potential P2W scenarios.[/b]

[i]Metro Conflict: The Origin’s package nature will include the following;[/i]
[list]	
[*]Starting with our Early Access launch, Metro Conflict: The Origin is expected to be available for $19.99 through Steam.
[*]Full range of all 12 characters will be made available.
[*]All weapons are permanent once purchased and will be made available through the in-game store via credits obtained through gameplay. (collectable through gameplay; non-cash oriented)
[*]There are various character and weapon skins available to be obtained either through; gameplay and/or events. These skins offer cosmetic effects but do not alter weapon mechanics.
[/list]
Our 1st CBT is scheduled to start from October 27th. We recommended everyone to personally experience these changes during our Beta Testing. We’ll be anticipating valuable feedback during and after our 1st CBT.
Metro Conflict: The Origin will mature through your ideas and feedback!

Team MC.

notes.title: Dev. Note #1. Greetings!
notes.content:
[b]First and foremost, our sincerely appreciation towards all of our users for having interest in Metro Conflict: The Origin. We are the development team for Metro Conflict: The Origin at, Red Duck, Inc; South Korean game developer specializing in FPS games.

We are planning to launch Metro Conflict: The Origin through Early Access. This decision is based on our willingness to actively communicate with our users in order to mold Metro Conflict: The Origin according to our community feedback. Therefore, Dev. Notes, to us, is considered to be one of the most important channels of communication for us towards our valued users.

From this point forward, we will share our thoughts and plans for the development as well as services for Metro Conflict: The Origin through the Dev. Notes. We will also provide detailed description of key updates and changes to important elements of the game. Dev. Notes will also be an official channel to answer major questions & concerns of our community.[/b]

[i]Let’s get started with our first official post!
We thought it would be appropriate to clarify the difference between Metro Conflict of the past and the new release; Metro Conflict: The Origin.[/i]
[list]	
[*]Metro Conflict: The Origin does differ from Metro Conflict of the past.
[*]Metro Conflict: The Origin is a refined version where all previous content and system adaptations have been reviewed upon and simplified/rebalanced in order to provide our users with a true ‘core’ FPS experience; refocusing on ‘sharp-shooting’ and ‘element-utilization’. The name, Metro Conflict: The Origin, appropriately reflects our approach back to the foundational elements of a great FPS game.
[*]Major changes applied to the game with respect to the aforementioned background is as follows;
- Each character and their primary skills have been revised. Secondary skills have been added.
- Main weapons have all been rebalanced.
- Previous game modes have been removed. EXD (Extreme Domination) mode has been improved and further developed to become the main game mode.
- Game cost and related explanation
[/list]

Each aforementioned topic will be covered in detail through further Dev. Notes. Thank you again to all of our users and we ask for your continued attention and support.

Team MC.
